name: PlayBound Menu Cursor — HoloCure
notes: HoloCure plays natively on a controller, but PippleCultist's multiplayer mod menus (Play/Multiplayer, network adapter, Host/Join LAN) only answer the mouse. This profile runs alongside the native pad and only adds a cursor: right stick moves it, right-stick click (R3) left-clicks. HoloCure uses neither natively, so gameplay is unchanged.
